0022600126.text: The Grizzlies (2-0, on a two-game winning streak and 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back) visit the Utah Jazz (1-2, on a one-game losing streak and 5th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back). Memphis is missing Karim Lopez (knee bruise) and Zach Edey (ankle), while Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). The Grizzlies lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 123-103 win in Memphis on October 21, and the teams split their 2025-26 meetings 2-2.
